data.narrative:
Shield AI, a Series G defense and security company, was last valued at $12.7B post-money after raising $1.5B+. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of eight private peers in the Defense & Security sector with similar valuation profiles, supplemented by two public comparables.

Two methods triangulate fair value. Stage-progression applies a 1.25x multiplier typical of Series G advancement, yielding $15.9B. Peer-median analysis across the eight-company set—including Anduril Industries ($61.0B Series H), Helsing ($18.0B Series D), Flock Safety ($7.5B Series G), Saronic ($9.2B Series D), and Quantum-Systems ($8.0B Series C)—produces a median of $7.8B, though the peer range spans $3.0B to $61.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage, technology, and market positioning within the sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $6.6B (low) to $18.3B (high), with a median of $11.8B. Shield AI's current $12.7B valuation sits above the peer median but within the range, reflecting its relative stage maturity and capital raised. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to higher-valued peers like Anduril, path to revenue, and customer concentration in the defense industrial base.
